sql_query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
      THEN 'Delivered after estimate'
    ELSE 'Delivered on or before estimate'
  END AS delivery_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT LEFT(o.order_id, 10)) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
      THEN 'Delivered after estimate'
    ELSE 'Delivered on or before estimate'
  END
ORDER BY delivery_status;
